representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > run_deseq2.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
counts_path <- args[[1]]
sample_path <- args[[2]]
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
counts_df <- read.csv(counts_path, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
sample_df <- read.csv(sample_path, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
sample_df$CountColumn <- gsub('-', '_', sample_df$SampleID, fixed=TRUE)
keep_meta <- sample_df[sample_df$Group %in% c('DMSO','CBD_IC50'), ]
if (nrow(keep_meta) != 6) stop('Expected 3 DMSO and 3 CBD_IC50 samples')
if (!all(keep_meta$CountColumn %in% colnames(counts_df))) {
  stop(paste('Missing count columns:', paste(setdiff(keep_meta$CountColumn, colnames(counts_df)), collapse=',')))
}
count_mat <- as.matrix(counts_df[, keep_meta$CountColumn, drop=FALSE])
storage.mode(count_mat) <- 'integer'
colnames(count_mat) <- keep_meta$CountColumn
rownames(keep_meta) <- keep_meta$CountColumn
keep_meta$Group <- factor(keep_meta$Group, levels=c('DMSO','CBD_IC50'))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=count_mat, colData=keep_meta, design=~Group)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c('Group','CBD_IC50','DMSO'), alpha=0.05)
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$gene_id <- rownames(res_df)
res_df <- res_df[, c('gene_id', setdiff(names(res_df), 'gene_id'))]
write.table(res_df, file='de_results.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na='NA')
fg <- !is.na(res_df$padj) & !is.na(res_df$log2FoldChange) & res_df$padj < 0.05 & abs(res_df$log2FoldChange) > 0.5
up <- res_df$gene_id[fg & res_df$log2FoldChange > 0.5]
down <- res_df$gene_id[fg & res_df$log2FoldChange < -0.5]
universe <- res_df$gene_id[!is.na(res_df$pvalue)]
writeLines(up, 'up_genes.txt')
writeLines(down, 'down_genes.txt')
writeLines(universe, 'universe_genes.txt')
summary_df <- data.frame(
  contrast='CBD_IC50_vs_DMSO',
  reference='DMSO',
  target='CBD_IC50',
  alpha=0.05,
  log2fc_abs_threshold=0.5,
  tested_genes=length(universe),
  significant_up=length(up),
  significant_down=length(down),
  stringsAsFactors=FALSE
)
write.table(summary_df, file='de_summary.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
RSCRIPT
Rscript run_deseq2.R "$(inputs.counts.path)" "$(inputs.samples.path)"

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)

counts_df <- read.csv(counts_path, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
sample_df <- read.csv(sample_path, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
sample_df$CountColumn <- gsub('-', '_', sample_df$SampleID, fixed=TRUE)
keep_meta <- sample_df[sample_df$Group %in% c('DMSO','CBD_IC50'), ]
if (nrow(keep_meta) != 6) stop('Expected 3 DMSO and 3 CBD_IC50 samples')

  stop(paste('Missing count columns:', paste(setdiff(keep_meta$CountColumn, colnames(counts_df)), collapse=',')))
}
count_mat <- as.matrix(counts_df[, keep_meta$CountColumn, drop=FALSE])
storage.mode(count_mat) <- 'integer'
colnames(count_mat) <- keep_meta$CountColumn
rownames(keep_meta) <- keep_meta$CountColumn
keep_meta$Group <- factor(keep_meta$Group, levels=c('DMSO','CBD_IC50'))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=count_mat, colData=keep_meta, design=~Group)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c('Group','CBD_IC50','DMSO'), alpha=0.05)
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$gene_id <- rownames(res_df)
res_df <- res_df[, c('gene_id', setdiff(names(res_df), 'gene_id'))]
write.table(res_df, file='de_results.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na='NA')
fg <- !is.na(res_df$padj) & !is.na(res_df$log2FoldChange) & res_df$padj < 0.05 & abs(res_df$log2FoldChange) > 0.5
up <- res_df$gene_id[fg & res_df$log2FoldChange > 0.5]
down <- res_df$gene_id[fg & res_df$log2FoldChange < -0.5]
universe <- res_df$gene_id[!is.na(res_df$pvalue)]
writeLines(up, 'up_genes.txt')
writeLines(down, 'down_genes.txt')
writeLines(universe, 'universe_genes.txt')
summary_df <- data.frame(
  contrast='CBD_IC50_vs_DMSO',
  reference='DMSO',
  target='CBD_IC50',
  alpha=0.05,
  log2fc_abs_threshold=0.5,
  tested_genes=length(universe),
  significant_up=length(up),
  significant_down=length(down),
  stringsAsFactors=FALSE
)
write.table(summary_df, file='de_summary.tsv', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
